title: ReviewSync
tagline: Import your reviews from one app to another (e.g. Uber to Cabify)! Never start from 0 again!
description: ReviewSync allows you to import your ratings from different platforms (e.g. Uber, Lyft, Airbnb, Facebook Marketplace) and import them onto the blockchain. If you join a new platform (e.g. Cabify, Didi), they can see the ratings linked to your wallet address so you can be assigned a rating based on your average rating, # of ratings, # of verified platforms, and age of accounts instead of starting from 0.
how_its_made:
- Built the frontend with Next.js using the Scaffold-ETH template for fast wallet + contract integration.
- Wrote and deployed smart contracts with Hardhat on the Flare testnet to store cross-platform rating data and generate token rewards using Flare RNG.
- Integrated World ID to verify each user is a unique human, preventing duplicate or fake ReviewSync identities.
- Used Filecoin to store rating-verification evidence (screenshots, proofs) in a decentralized, tamper-resistant way.
- Used Google Gemini 2.5 Flash to analyze uploaded rating screenshots and extract structured review details automatically.
